Name: JP's Crazy Tools
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=6][b][i][u][center]Crazy Tools[/center][/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]

[color=#9900ff][size=5][i][b]Because there can't be anything more fun than cutting down a tree using a watering can...[/b][/i][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]This mod simply allows you to use one tool as another, an axe that can chop stone, chop down a tree with a fishing rod, you see where it goes.[/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]It is a mod nothing serious, to have fun for a while and nothing more, it is fully configurable to choose what properties each tool should have. [/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3][b]The most destructive part of the mod is to use any tool as a Pan, which means that you can use it anywhere and get minerals without even having water on the map. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list]
[youtube]HCA4Akgnptc[/youtube]

[color=#ff00ff][size=6][i][u]
Translations:[/u][/i][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=4][color=#f4f4f4][/color]If you want, you can make the translation of this mod, [color=#ff0000]no need to ask for permission[/color], and you can publish it on your own in Nexus. [color=#ffff00]This is best because I won't be available to update the translations if you send it to me.[/color] [color=#f4f4f4][/color][/size]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]I will not do the usual translations into Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese either, so you are more than welcome to do translations into these languages. [/size][/color]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][size=4]If you like you can let me know when you have published your translations so that I know you are there.[/size][size=3] [/size][/color]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=5]Thank you![/size][/color]
[/list][/font]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and move the folder directly to the Mods folder. If you like the mod, click the “Endorse” button at the top of the page ;)
